To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

software pipelining can be used for improving the throughput of a NoC based system, and the benefits of software pipelination are more pronounced when voltage/frequency scaling is used for both the processors and the communication links.

software pipelining can significantly improve the performance of the NoC based systems and that voltage/frequency scaling of processors and communication links can further improve the performance of software-pipelined systems.

(1) software pipelining is an effective compiler optimization for NoC based systems, (2) software pipelined programs are more sensitive to voltage/frequency scaling than their non-pipelined counterparts, (3) software pipeliner programs can benefit more from link scaling, and (4) software pipelination is more beneficial for programs with high communication-to-computation ratios

software pipelining is a promising technique for improving the energy-efficiency of the embedded NoCs.
software pipelining has a significant impact on the power and energy consumption of NoC based architectures, especially when the number of cores is large and the communication links are not scaled.
